svg.title: Covers, norm maps and elliptic factors
svg.desc: A geometric cover gives a subgroup embedding on prime-to-degree torsion; it does not change the target order.
svg.text: Covers, norm maps and elliptic factors
A geometric cover gives a subgroup embedding on prime-to-degree torsion; it does not change the target order.
All maps and equations are over the same field 𝔽p.
The product decomposition is through a (2,2)-isogeny.
If n is odd, the embedded subgroup still has order n.
These are fiber data on the even-degree model, not an arbitrary reduced class.
Smooth plane quartic; dim Prym = 2. The degree-two norm identity also holds.
Characteristic >3. ECCp-131 satisfies the smoothness conditions. The symbol ∼ denotes an isogeny, not equality of groups or polarizations.
